claims.text: 'events watch <sub> --since <cursor> --max N --timeout S' drains: resume the session, consume up to --max, append to the history store, acknowledge, return the batch plus the next cursor; defaults are non-infinite (--max 100, --timeout 30) and there is no unbounded --follow in this arc
